timing: Before any new cohort dispatch or output; prior frozen rubric retained and adapted only for four new disease-goal cases.
unit: Four frozen new disease questions, one fresh start per instruction procedure, eight planned episodes; nested source claims.
masking: Use W identifiers, hide procedure labels until all content reviews are frozen. The preparation agent also reviews; this is not independent external validation.
retrieval_scope: Returned source records and their exact original passages. Source retrieval can differ by procedure; preserve failed, partial and unread sources. Do not apply the previous 60-fact answer key.

outcomes.name: question_coverage
units: disease-specific mechanism or requested target/isoform comparison
requested computation or justified input-dependent deferral
outcomes.rule: All four new questions begin without a target or candidate answer; require distinct disease-specific mechanisms. Existing target-specified GPT cases remain in their old cohort only.

outcomes.name: source_fidelity
claim_selection: Every material source-dependent assertion in recommendation and reason.
For each alternative and each hypothesis, its main mechanistic or quantitative evidence claim; verify distinct additional numerical assertions in those selected evidence objects.
Identity, target link, measured/predicted/proposed status and relevant conditions for each candidate explicitly selected in the final recommendation.
Each parameter represented as an existing observation in the selected next action. Clearly proposed future parameters are not empirical assertions.
outcomes.rule: Keep exact output and original source pointers. Count a repeated semantic assertion once. Report additional directly reproduced claims outside this selection separately; do not silently expand one arm denominator.

outcomes.name: local_citation
outcomes.rule: A true statement citing the wrong source is an attribution defect, separate from a false factual assertion.

outcomes.name: candidate_integrity
units: actual identity with source or explicitly proposed new entity
valid structure/sequence and declared parent provenance
target/mechanism link or explicit unresolved status
outcomes.rule: Use exact artifact-scoped IDs. Structure identity checks do not establish activity or physical vial identity.

outcomes.name: next_action
outcomes.rule: Judge the selected useful next action, with exact quotes. A justified retrieval/analysis can be a useful next action. Record its actual operation kind and source/outcome links separately from prose quality.

outcomes.name: actual_tool_use
units: genuine missing input vs connected capability omitted
outcomes.rule: No invented execution. Reproduce alleged omitted registered capability against frozen schema and actual IDs on a copy before classifying it. Do not execute docking or revise scoring functions.

outcomes.name: pool_and_product_links
units: new proposal not relabeled measured or validated
outcomes.rule: Automated counts establish record presence and referential links only; scientific support is manually reviewed.

outcomes.name: browser_acceptance
units: disease-specific mechanisms instead of placeholder cache
click through to exact original passage and figure/caption when available
candidate identity and actual 2D structure or RNA sequence
outcomes.rule: Require actual browser evidence for UI success. JSON availability alone is not browser acceptance. Caption retrieval is not interpretation of the figure image.

aggregation: Report all eight planned, admitted, returned, final-published, failed, time-limited and not-admitted episodes. Four disease pairs; no weighted score, pooled GPT/Claude percentage, or claim-level independent significance test.
partial_failure: Retain every started run. No-answer provider failures have no semantic score. Budget-limited partial work and tool/network errors are different categories. Unstarted held runs are not scientific failures.
runtime: Same new dedicated evaluation subscription scope, maximum four evaluation lanes; operational scope unchanged. Five ordinary responses including framing/final and one format correction. Equal 35-minute new-admission budget; already-started tool returns retained and any overrun reported. Each provider timeout is at most600sec or remaining deadline.
public_export_note: Only the private predecessor filesystem path was replaced with a logical ID; all rubric criteria are unchanged. Actual C/D/E review labels implement the planned masking; preparer knows procedures.
